ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol to value, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, TSLA. Letters/dot/hyphen only; the analysis upper-cases on the back end.

wacc.description: Weighted Average Cost of Capital — the annual discount rate applied to projected free cash flows. Typical equity WACC sits between 7% and 12% (0.07–0.12). Higher WACC → lower valuation.

terminal_growth.description: Perpetual growth rate after the explicit projection period. Anchor below long-run GDP growth (2–3%). MUST be smaller than WACC or the terminal value diverges.

projection_years.description: How many years of free cash flow to project explicitly before applying terminal value. 5 years is standard for stable companies; 7–10 for growth names.
